- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Momos have become popular in other parts of the world and are enjoyed by people of many different cultural backgrounds.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Whether nuclear proliferation is justified for deterrence is a highly debated issue with valid arguments on both sides.
